compatibility: Historical Git commits retain original paths; maintained in-repository readers point to canonical destinations. Root manifests/entrypoints and actual package/runtime interfaces are preserved.
classification_coverage: Every tracked root file and top-level directory classified; internal source/subject package structure retained under its declared parent role.

root_readme_source.note: Original pre-edit prose remains recoverable at this Git commit; translations and current layout prose do not rewrite prior history.
